scope: P1a helper effects only. Logical slots, immutable program loads, specialization intrinsics, publication/root proofs and P1b common graph lowering remain open.
contract: Nupp field annotations declare all four boolean effects. The validator reads checked semantic metadata, rejects absent/duplicate/incomplete/malformed summaries and rejects pure plus collect/park/raise. Non-collecting operations do not imply purity. Call/lookup summaries conservatively include guest callbacks; OS blocking is not guest-task parking.
ownership: The effect contract and its validator are Nupp. Current native lowering validates declarations before importing helper calls; graph consumers can use the same semantic metadata and validator. No Rust helper-name effect switch or CLIF semantic optimizer is added.

validation.command: NUPP_VM_AUTO_REBUILD=0 ./bin/nupp check --json src/nupp/compiler/vm/helpercontract.nupp src/nupp/compiler/clif/lower.nupp src/nupp/runtime/vm/effects.nupp src/nupp/runtime/vm/helpers.d.nupp src/nupp/runtime/vm/os.d.nupp
NUPP_VM_AUTO_REBUILD=0 ./bin/nupp test annotationtest nativeclosurestest nativeheaptest nativejittest nativeruntimetest nativestringstest nativetablestest --jobs=2
